'''Virtual Original''' — [[Brainiac (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)]] (1115_8)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Brainiac (V)]] (1210_90) |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=FinishFoil |printed_title=ブレイニアック |printed_game_text=*戦闘力＝√3 (X－Y) +2 (A－B) +π（最低でも戦闘力＝1）。X＝ダークサイドの手札の枚数、Y＝ライトサイドの手札の枚数、A＝場に出ているカードのダークアイコンの合計数、B＝場に出ているカードのライトアイコンの合計数、π＝3.141592653589793238462643383...である。 |printed_lore=''ボシェックはこのシニティーンの男性に“ブレイニアック（頭でっかち）”というあだ名をつけた。その名にふさわしく、彼はハイパースペースの座標を自分の頭で計算できる。レイアの脱獄作戦も、彼が立案していたらさぞかし…'' |translation='''Title:''' Brainiac. '''Card text:''' *Power = √3 (X−Y) +2 (A−B) + π (power is at least 1). X is the Dark Side hand size. Y is the Light Side hand size. A is the total Dark icons on table. B is the total Light icons on table. π is 3.141592653589793238462643383… '''Lore:''' Boshek gave this Sanyassan male the nickname Brainiac (big-headed). True to the name, he can calculate hyperspace coordinates in his head. If only he had been the one to plan Leia's escape… '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore glosses the nickname as 頭でっかち. |notes='''Brainiac (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Brainiac|Brainiac]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Brainiac (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R56 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30, Reflections II foil cards, R56. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[[:File:Japanese-Brainiac-Reflections-II-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. title: Luke Skywalker (Japanese Reflections III Foil)
text: {{Card |title=Luke Skywalker |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] |set=Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty |set_display=[[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] |language=ja |language_display=Japanese |label_language=Printed language |navigation=[[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] |publication_id=decipher-reflections-iii-luke-skywalker-foil-ja |image=Japanese-Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg |lead='''Luke Skywalker''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]]. |rarity=SR |rarity_display=[[Rarity|SR]] |destiny=1 |power=3 |ability=4 |deploy=3 |forfeit=7 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions={{Card versions/Luke Skywalker (Premiere)}} |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=FinishFoil |printed_title=ルーク・スカイウォーカー |printed_game_text=タトゥイーン以外のロケーションにルークがいる場合、毎ターン、フォースを1多く起動できる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋3。レッド5を操縦する場合、さらに回避値に＋2。耐：損耗＜3。 |printed_lore=''アナキン・スカイウォーカーの息子。オビ＝ワン・ケノービの弟子。Ｔ－16スカイホッパーに乗って、ベガーズ・キャニオンのウォンプ・ラットを狙い撃ちして操縦技能を磨いた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Luke Skywalker. '''Card text:''' If Luke is at a location other than Tatooine, you may activate 1 additional Force each turn. Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. When piloting Red 5, also adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition < 3. '''Lore:''' Son of Anakin Skywalker. Pupil of Obi-Wan Kenobi. He honed his piloting skill by shooting womp rats in Beggar's Canyon from a T-16 skyhopper. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Unlike the [[Luke Skywalker (Reflections Foil)|English Reflections foil]], this Japanese foil retains the earlier activation condition (Luke at a location other than Tatooine) and limits the piloting power bonus to a starship. The English foil’s November 1998 revisions instead require that Luke is not at a Tatooine site for the extra activation, and apply the piloting bonus to anything he pilots.Printed faces: [[:File:Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-Foil-PSA.jpg|English Reflections foil]] and [[:File:Japanese-Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Japanese Reflections III foil]]. |errata_history=[[Decipher Glossary 2.0|Decipher’s Glossary Version 2.0]] publishes the English replacement text on p. 89 and states on p. 2 that its revised gameplay applies to all versions of the affected cards as of November 1998. The Japanese foil’s unchanged printing does not rescind that erratum.[http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], [[Decipher]] (November 1998), pp. 1–2 and 89. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. |notes='''Luke Skywalker (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]]. {{Card |title=Trample |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty |set_display=[[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] |language=ja |language_display=Japanese |label_language=Printed language |navigation=[[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] |publication_id=decipher-reflections-iii-trample-foil-ja |image=Japanese-Trample-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg |lead='''Trample''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]]. |rarity=VR |rarity_display=[[Rarity|VR]] |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Trample]] (3_138o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Trample (Japanese)]] (1303_138o)
'''Decipher (Japanese Reflections III foil)''' — '''this printing'''
'''Decipher (Reflections II foil)''' — [[Trample (Reflections II Foil)|Trample (foil)]]
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Trample (Errata)]] (3_138) |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=FinishFoil |printed_title=蹂躙（じゅうりん） |printed_game_text=パイロットが搭乗している自分のＡＴ－ＡＴと同じ屋外の位置にいるキャラクター、“クラッシュ”したビークル、パイロット搭乗していない回避値を持つビークルのいずれか1つを目標とする。運命数を引く。目標がキャラクターなら運命数＞能力値でロストする。目標がビークルなら運命数＜7でロストする。 |printed_lore=''ウォーカーの巨大な足は様々な地形を踏み越えられるように設計されている。残忍なパイロットは、反乱軍を文字どおり踏みつぶすのにこれを使用する。'' |translation='''Title:''' Trample. '''Card text:''' At the same outdoor location as your piloted AT-AT, target one character, crashed vehicle, or unpiloted vehicle with maneuver. Draw destiny. A character target is lost if destiny exceeds ability. A vehicle target is lost if destiny is less than 7. '''Lore:''' The walker's enormous feet are designed to step across a variety of terrain. Ruthless pilots use them to literally crush the Rebellion. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face names a piloted AT-AT. |notes='''Trample (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Trample|Trample]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Trample (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R42 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R42. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[[:File:Japanese-Trample-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins. |see_also=* [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese foils|Japanese foils]] |see_also_heading=See Also |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] |uniqueness=Unrestricted }}

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Vader's Lightsaber (V)]] (219_27)
'''Virtual Modern (ALT)''' — [[Vader's Lightsaber (V) (ALT)]] (219_27^) |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=FinishFoil |printed_title=ベイダーのライトセーバー |printed_game_text=必ずベイダーに配備すること（コストなし）。このカードがある場所のフォース消耗に＋1できる。武器使用時は、コストなしで1名のキャラクターに対して起動できる。運命数を2回引き、運命数の合計＞能力値なら、そのキャラクターに命中し、没収値＝0にできる。 |printed_lore=''ダース・ベイダーの自作。クローン大戦の後、彼はこの武器を振るってジェダイたちを狩りたてた。他のライトセーバーの刃以外なら、何でも切断できる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Vader's Lightsaber. '''Card text:''' Deploy only on Vader at no cost. You may add 1 to the Force drain where this card is. You may fire at one character at no cost. Draw destiny twice. If total destiny exceeds the character's ability, it is hit and its forfeit can be reduced to 0. '''Lore:''' Built by Darth Vader. After the Clone Wars he used it to hunt Jedi. It can cut anything except another lightsaber blade. |notes='''Vader's Lightsaber (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Vader's Lightsaber|Vader's Lightsaber]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Vader's Lightsaber (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R50 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R50. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[[:File:Japanese-Vaders-Lightsaber-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins. |see_also=* [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese foils|Japanese foils]] |see_also_heading=See Also |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}
